review.gallery: Eight renders from the Views II listing and its branded brochure, plus a dated progress photograph from the developer’s Views II gallery. The lead and card show the signed Views II tower arrivals. No finished-building claim is inferred from the photo.
review.location: Brochure page 4 visually identifies Views II next to the golf course. Fourteen times match the original project brief. Haus & Estates uses the same Ellington Views Google point for both phases, so the pin is explicitly shared and approximate. Wynn’s 5 November 2026 Q3 results give an expected September 2027 opening.
review.floorPlans: Thirty-one complete original drawings: 16 homes, 12 typical floor plates and 3 amenities sheets. The 1 BR Type 3 and Type 4 examples have equal totals but distinct drawings. The same is true of the 2 BR and 2 BR with study Type 1 examples. The brochure depicts a floor 18 lounge in a render but provides no corresponding 18th-floor drawing.

unavailable: Surveyed Views II entrance, independent floor 18 drawing, contracted areas and photographed finished interiors.
